memories.content: On 2026-08-20 Wen, Mara's pottery teacher, invited her to put a couple of pieces into a group show of the studio's work; Mara decided to do it despite her nerves.

entities.name: Wen
entities.description: Mara's pottery teacher at Clay & Co

memories.content: The Clay & Co studio group show featuring Mara's pottery is scheduled for 2026-09-19 (a Saturday) at the studio.
Mara reflected (2026-08-20) that pottery, which she once dismissed as a silly distraction that probably wouldn't stick, has grown into something she is exhibiting in a show.
Mara gave up trying to switch from coffee to matcha and is back on coffee (noted 2026-08-20).

Mara prepared a set of three small bowls to glaze for the September Clay & Co show (as of 2026-08-20), and wished Daniel could be in Toronto for it, which hinged on the Nautilus transfer still being undecided.
When Mara doubted her bowls were gallery-worthy, Wen told her (2026-08-20) that whether the work belongs in the show is 'for the room' to decide, not Mara.

entities.name: Wen
entities.description: Mara's pottery teacher at Clay & Co
